meta.title: Next message
meta.description: Shows a predicted next message inside the composer and fills it in on Tab. Follows the current session model by default and can use a separate, cheaper model.

title: Next message
description: When the session is idle and the composer is empty, predicts what you are likely to send next. Press Tab to fill the draft; nothing is sent automatically.
enabledHint: Show one suggestion in the empty composer after each completed turn.
modelHint: Follows the model of the current session by default. Pin a faster, cheaper route if you prefer.
unavailable: Configuration is unavailable. Check that the plugin is enabled and DSH finished loading.
